# Genealogy Research Partner for Muse

Turns Muse into a disciplined genealogy research partner for your family history: it reads scans, photos, and database screenshots of parish, civil, census, military, and migration records in any language — including handwritten historical scripts such as Latin, Cyrillic, Gothic/Kurrent, Hebrew, Greek, and Ottoman Arabic — and works to the Genealogical Proof Standard, tagging every conclusion as Proven, Probable, Possible, Unresolved, or Disproven while classifying each source, information type, and piece of evidence. It keeps your project organized in an Obsidian vault (People, Places, Documents, Events, Research) with a research tracker, validates and patches GEDCOM files with citation-backed edits, and researches local-first: archives, databases, and queries in each jurisdiction's own language and historical terminology, with native-script search vocabularies per country. Ships with reference guides for GEDCOM workflows, archive and API catalogs, country-level databases, naming conventions, and common pitfalls. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: it's a research partner, not an archive key — anything behind a login, subscription, or CAPTCHA (record downloads, paid databases, archive visits) still needs you, and it never runs unsolicited searches without a research plan. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
